== Objectives ==
Slay 10 Sisters of Rot, 10 Whispering Satyrs, and 5 Rotting Ancients in Elun’aran, then return to Sister Mirallun in the Grove of the Sun.
* [[Sister of Rot]] slain (10)
* [[Whispering Satyr]] slain (10)
* [[Rotting Ancient]] slain (5)

== Description ==
The corruption you saw in the Grove of the Moon is only the beginning.

To the north lies Elun’aran, a sacred village once tended by druids who honored both the forest and the moon.

Now it festers.

The same druids who abandoned Cenarius’ teachings have spread their influence there. Their rituals twist the land, and creatures of rot now roam beneath the ancient trees.

Even some of my own kin have fallen.

Dryads corrupted by their magic now call themselves the Sisters of Rot. Satyrs whisper in the shadows, feeding the madness that spreads through the groves.

And the ancients… the great guardians of the forest… they have begun to decay while still walking.

This cannot continue.

Travel to Elun’aran and cleanse the grove. Slay ten Sisters of Rot, ten Whispering Satyrs, and five Rotting Ancients.

==Rewards==
* 7800 [[XP]]

== Progress ==
Do not linger too long in Elun’aran.

The forest there no longer dreams peacefully. Something darker watches through its roots.

== Completion ==
You have done what was necessary.

The forest breathes a little easier already.

But the druids who began this corruption still remain… and one of them leads the others.
